trd_definition: Two adequate antidepressant failures; PRD/TRD criteria for trials
finding: Operational definition improves standardization but explicitly reflects unresolved definition controversies.

trd_definition: TRD concept with categorical and dimensional assessment
finding: Experts considered dimensional treatment-resistance assessment useful because of heterogeneity.
Shows adequacy of prior treatment is a measurable prerequisite and includes pharmacotherapy, psychotherapy and brain stimulation.
TRD prevalence changed from 52.97% to 28.81%; stricter definition predicted worse outcome.
Substantial pseudo-resistance due to inadequate trials/nonadherence; few predictors generalize across treatment modalities.
Remission declined across treatment steps and relapse increased among those requiring more steps.
Chronicity, comorbidity, lower function and socioeconomic disadvantage associated with poorer outcomes.
Severity, psychosis, suicidality, anxiety, episode duration and recurrence predicted TRD.

design: Multicenter prediction with external cohort extension
finding: Chronicity, severity, hospitalization, episodes, BMI and functioning dominated prediction; prospective validation still needed.
Most repeated predictors were severity, suicidality, recurrence; biological/imaging predictors too heterogeneous for common signal.
Genetic signal overlaps metabolic traits; supports inherited liability but not clean categorical boundary.
SNP heritability detected; strong genetic correlations with bipolar disorder and schizophrenia; treatment-resistance locus evidence limited.
Polygenic correlates span cognitive, temperamental and sleep traits; cross-trait enrichment rather than a unique TRD genome.
Genetic component is measurable but modest and heterogeneous; supports stratification research more than one disease boundary.
Baseline resting-state measures predicted later TRD in small sample (17 TRD/43 NRD); requires independent validation.
Reduced hippocampal volume and network differences recur, but methods and results remain inconsistent.
Baseline CRP moderated escitalopram vs nortriptyline outcome; treatment interaction, not TRD disease classifier.
Inflammatory markers showed treatment-moderating signals; companion analyses from same parent trial.
Higher BMI-corrected CRP in TRD, but CRP tracked BMI, vegetative/anxiety/adversity features; no temporality.
No overall infliximab benefit; exploratory baseline-CRP treatment interaction suggests possible inflammatory subgroup.
Pooled inflammatory association, but variable thresholds/confounding and study-family overlap; no biomarker-guided prospective trials.
Meta-analytic inflammatory signals exist, but evidence does not yet establish routine biomarker-guided treatment.
Large expression/immune-epigenetic differences reported; discovery-stage, treatment-exposed and not prospectively validated.
TRD associated with longer illness, greater comorbidity, utilization and ~1.5x healthcare costs.
Baseline clinical/health-service factors predicted later medication-defined TRD; definition partly reflects care pathway.
Health utilization, provider specialty, prescriptions and untreated duration predicted TRD; transition often prolonged, suggesting care-system effects.
Treatment-line trajectories identify incident TRD as a longitudinal treatment-course state.
Multiple mechanistically different treatments improve TRD outcomes; treatment efficacy validates care pathway but not one pathology.
Multidimensional barriers (patient, illness, treatment) favored over simple resistance in complex cases; useful for service provision.
Age-adapted operational definition/staging highlights jurisdiction and population-specific classification needs.

trd_definition: Episode-wide Maudsley staging plus categorical remission/TRD outcomes
finding: Episode-wide dimensional resistance incorporated episode duration severity failed antidepressants augmentation and ECT and discriminated categorical outcomes; supports graded trajectory/stage representation.

design: MDD neuroimaging clustering with multi-omics N=807 total
finding: Three neuroimaging MDD subtypes showed different multi-omic patterns; one inflammation-linked subtype and one genetic/synaptic subtype. Proof-of-concept, not yet externally validated as treatment taxonomy.

design: Metabolomic subtype discovery with independent Whitehall II validation
finding: Three metabolomic depression subtypes were identified with independent cohort validation of subtype-specific models; treatment-resistance mapping remains unestablished.

design: Exploratory MDD multi-omics subtype study N=134; 83 multi-omics
trd_definition: MDD before 8-week antidepressant outcome; not TRD-selected
finding: Three immune-inflammatory-metabolic subtypes differed in 8-week antidepressant response; MoS2 had poorer response, but independent external validation is required.

design: Human systemic immune profiling with cross-disease computational comparison
finding: MDD shared systemic immune abnormalities with inflammatory skin disease including a type-2/Th2-related signal, suggesting a possible immune subgroup and repurposing hypothesis; not a validated TRD classifier.
